participant_a_prompt_text: Your partner will tell you about a time they struggled with making a decision. Ask follow-up questions to understand their thought process and offer your own insights on how you handle similar situations.
participant_b_prompt_text: Describe a time when you had trouble making a decision, and it took you longer than usual to come to a conclusion. What were the factors that contributed to your indecisiveness, and how did you ultimately decide?
